name: slidev-theme-redhat
description: Red Hat brand theme for Slidev, built for clean export to Google Slides

comments.transition: Transitions are dropped by the pptx export, so the theme does not pay the dev-server cost of animating them.
comments.fonts: Pulled from Google Fonts at build time. A .pptx names fonts rather than embedding them, so recipients still need Red Hat Display/Text installed or they will see a fallback.
